# FAMILY 1: stats, abilities, Transform (status2 design)

Branch `calc-2v2-status-2` (from main 4008ee8), design only: nothing under `app/`, `tests/` or `docs/` changed, nothing committed.
The user asked to "do 3 and 4"; this family is the part of (3) that changes stat stages, stored stats, abilities and whole
builds, plus the narrow guards of (4) that sit on the same state (Imposter, Spit Up's Stockpile, the Trace and ability reads).

Ground truth: pinned Pokémon Showdown c23d2e94. `PS/` is the read-only source
`node_modules/.cache/champions/pokemon-showdown-c23d2e942c9c0daadb13a7162a385bf78e3c9353`. `SA<nn>` is a probe in
`stats-abilities-transform-probes.out` (this family's: 36 probes, 49 runs); `K<nn>` is CENSUS 1's (`census-moves-probes.out`);
`Q<nn>` is the earlier design's (`../../status-eot/design/status-probes-*.out`). App line numbers are the tree at 4008ee8.

Files (all in this folder):

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `stats-abilities-transform.md` | This design. |
| `stats-abilities-transform-probes.ts` → `.out` (`.err` empty) | 36 probes, 49 runs, on `../../status-eot/design/addendum-sim.ts` (every random decision enumerated, every move hits, crits only when certain, lowest roll unless "all rolls"). Reproduce: `npx --no-install tsx scripts/.cache/calc-audit/status2/design/stats-abilities-transform-probes.ts [SA01 ...]` from the repo root. |

Scope: the 32 status moves the orchestrator named (Acupressure, Psych Up, Power Swap, Guard Swap, Heart Swap, Speed Swap,
Power Split, Guard Split, Power Trick, Power Shift, Topsy-Turvy, Stockpile, Swallow, Stuff Cheeks, Tidy Up, No Retreat,
Autotomize, Minimize, Geomancy, Gear Up, Magnetic Flux, Flower Shield, Rototiller, Skill Swap, Role Play, Entrainment,
Simple Beam, Worry Seed, Gastro Acid, Doodle, Transform), Spit Up (damaging, reads Stockpile), and Imposter where the 2v2
engine meets it. CENSUS 1 also files Captivate and Tar Shot under "stat stages"; FAMILY 2 (types and volatiles) probes and
owns them (`types-volatiles-probes.ts`), so they are out of this document except where they meet the shared stage path (§3.1).

---

## 0. Summary of decisions

1. **Every named move becomes exact** in all four games where it exists, with these narrow reasons left (exact text in §12):
   ability Starts and Ends with no model yet (Supreme Overlord gained mid-turn, the form abilities, Illusion), Transform into a
   Dynamaxed target (SwSh) or into a Pokémon whose type changed this turn before FAMILY 2's per-world types land, Imposter with
   Tera/Dynamax or two levels (the 1v1's own withheld texts), and the existing Neutralizing Gas guard for the eight
   ability-changing moves until the gas-aware phase (§3.4.9, phase 6). Nothing in this family needs an approximation.
2. **status-table.ts kinds** (regenerated by `../../status-eot/build/track-a-gen-status-table.ts`): every named move goes from L
   to M (no condition) or C (exact under a stated condition, else a named reason), with a `handler` and `fails` key and a new
   `snatch` flag (FAMILY 3's Snatch reads it). §4 lists each.
3. **Four shared building blocks** this family owns and the other families reuse:
   - **Direct stage writes** (`writeStages`, doubles-status.ts): Psych Up, the three stage swaps, Topsy-Turvy, Transform, Costar
     and Curious Medicine write stages without `boost()`: no World.boosted entry (no Opportunist, Mirror Herb or Eject Pack: SA03,
     SA04b, SA04c, SA08, K14), no Defiant; a held White Herb then restores a received drop at the move's AfterMove (SA03, SA04b,
     SA08: `-enditem White Herb` right after the move).
   - **Stored-stat and weight overrides** on `BattleBuild` (`storedStats`, `weighthg`), read by `makePokemon` (calculate.ts:189)
     and `getBuildStats` (model.ts:315): Power Split, Guard Split, Speed Swap, Power Trick, Power Shift, Autotomize, Transform.
     Every reader of stored stats then sees them (the calculation's raw stats, Speed and the re-sort, the confusion self-hit,
     Strength Sap, Beast Boost, Download, Foul Play, Body Press). Any form change drops both (PS/sim/pokemon.ts:1387-1420 setSpecies
     recomputes storedStats and weighthg).
   - **The ability-change helper** (`setAbility`, new `doubles-abilities.ts`) with a generated per-game ability table
     (`app/lib/battle/ability-table.ts`): Showdown's order (End of the old ability, a fresh ability state, Start of the new), the
     flag tables (cantsuppress, failroleplay, failskillswap, noentrain, notrace, notransform per catalog), and a table of the
     Starts and Ends that act mid-turn (Intimidate with its gen-gated reactions, Download, Trace, the weather and terrain setters,
     Air Lock/Cloud Nine, Unnerve/As One, Screen Cleaner, Curious Medicine, Pastel Veil, Costar, Hospitality, Supersweet Syrup,
     Intrepid Sword, Dauntless Shield, Wind Rider, Slow Start, Truant; Ends of Flash Fire, Unburden, Slow Start, Unnerve, Air
     Lock/Cloud Nine, the strong weathers, Protosynthesis/Quark Drive). Gen 8+ priorities follow on their own (SA14).
   - **The transformed build** (`transformBuild`): species, pre-Tera types, stored stats (any level: SA19d), weight (SA19c),
     all seven stages, crit volatiles and ability (its Start: SA19), keeping its own HP, item, status, level, Tera and gender.
4. **Stockpile is state**: `MoveVolatiles.stockpile = { layers, def, spd }` (the counted stats: SA09b, SA09c), carried in
   `DoublesCarried.stockpile`; Swallow and Spit Up read it (Spit Up through a new `MoveContext.stockpile` the 2v2 alone sets, so
   the 1v1 is untouched), and its End lowers exactly the counted stats through `boost()` (SA09, SA09b, SA09c).
5. **Minimize** is a ×2 inside the calculation's final-modifier chain (an `engine-corrections.cjs` hook), not a doubling of the
   result: SA13 shows 105 where 2 × 53 = 106 under Reflect.
6. **Acupressure** is the only new branch here besides Trace's: one world per stat below +6, 1/n each (SA01, SA02b, Q14).
7. **Imposter** stops being a settle failure: the settle transforms the Imposter holder into the foe across with the 1v1's
   rules (calculate.ts:486-542), with an assumption fact; Training builds the transformed Pokémon from the belief battle.
8. **Training**: `bridge.ts` maps the new volatiles (stockpile, powertrick, powershift, noretreat, minimize, gastroacid), the
   stored stats and weight a belief battle holds, a changed ability (a validation flag) and a transformed Pokémon, instead of
   rolling them out. This also fixes the stored-stat half of CENSUS 1's latent Training error (Power Split, Guard Split, Speed
   Swap on an earlier turn are read today as the set's stats). Nothing hidden is read (§10).
9. **E2** gains the stockpile counters, the accuracy and evasion stages, and new volatile ids; the builds carry the overrides.
10. **The 1v1 stays byte-equal**: every new field is set only by the 2v2 turn and Training, and every new branch in shared code
    (makePokemon, getBuildStats, calculateMove's Spit Up, the Minimize hook) is keyed on such a field.

## 2. What the engine does today with these moves

Every named move is kind L (status-table.ts) and goes through `doubles-status.ts statusMove`'s last branch (lines 778-786):
a later living action → the whole turn is `{Move} is not modelled and comes before another move.`; as the last action the
moves are estimated and the end of turn is `{Move} is not modelled.`. Stuff Cheeks and Swallow are presence guards wherever they
come (`HP_STATUS_MOVES`, doubles-actions.ts:63; doubles-status.ts:457). Under Neutralizing Gas from the turn's start, Gastro
Acid, Worry Seed, Simple Beam, Entrainment, Skill Swap, Role Play, Doodle and Transform are `{Move} with Neutralizing Gas is not
modelled in 2v2.` (GAS_CHANGING_MOVES, doubles-actions.ts:145; doubles-status.ts:776). Spit Up's row is needs-context
(`Needs the number of Stockpile uses.`, calculate.ts:60) so a turn with it is not estimated. Imposter anywhere is the settle's
`Imposter is not modelled in 2v2.` (calculate.ts:3189-3191). Training rolls out any unmapped volatile (bridge.ts:32-42, the
`{Name}: {id} is not modelled.` check), a foreign ability (`its ability was changed`), and a transformed Pokémon.

---

## 3. Shared building blocks

### 3.1 Stage writes: boost() versus direct writes

Two paths, chosen by what Showdown calls:

- **boost()** (`applyBoosts`, doubles-status.ts:2236, unchanged in behaviour): ChangeBoost (Contrary, Simple), the ±6 cap,
  TryBoost (Clear Amulet, Clear Body, Mirror Armor...), World.boosted (Opportunist, Mirror Herb, Eject Pack read it), Defiant and
  Competitive, White Herb. Used by Acupressure, Stockpile (and its End), Tidy Up, No Retreat, Autotomize, Minimize, Geomancy, Gear
  Up, Magnetic Flux, Flower Shield, Rototiller, Stuff Cheeks, Spit Up's and Swallow's Stockpile End, and every Start below that
  boosts (Intimidate, Download, Intrepid Sword, Dauntless Shield, Wind Rider, Supersweet Syrup).
- **Direct writes** (new `writeStages(kernel, w, slot, stages, use)` in doubles-status.ts): set `build.boosts` and
  `vol.stages` (accuracy, evasion) as given; no World.boosted entry, no TryBoost, no Defiant; `statsRaised`/`statsLowered` are not
  set (Showdown sets them only in boost(): PS/sim/battle.ts boost). Then the AfterMove White Herb: a working White Herb on the
  written Pokémon with a stage below 0 after the move is used (item gone, Unburden active, those stages to 0, accuracy and
  evasion included), as `applyBoosts` already does at lines 2324-2330 (move that block into a shared `whiteHerbAfterMove(kernel,
  w, slot, use)`). Used by Psych Up, Power Swap, Guard Swap, Heart Swap, Topsy-Turvy, Transform's copy, Costar and Curious
  Medicine's clear (Curious Medicine is a clearBoosts: no White Herb need since nothing is negative after).

The White Herb timing is exact for these moves because nothing else acts between their write and the move's AfterMove. Heart
Swap and Power/Guard Swap can leave both Pokémon below 0: each White Herb acts (they do not interact).

New accuracy and evasion stages enter `vol.stages` as today. They are read by nothing but Stored Power, Power Trip and Punishment,
which FAMILY 4 owns (`hidden-stages`, census-guards.md §B): its fix (the reader's positive accuracy and evasion stages as a
base-power override) is needed for SAT-ACU-2 below to be ready; until then those turns keep `{Move} with {Name}'s accuracy or
evasion stage from this turn is not modelled in 2v2.` (doubles-turn.ts:552-557), which Acupressure, Minimize, Psych Up, Heart
Swap and Transform now reach more often.

### 3.2 Stored stats: `BattleBuild.storedStats`

Contract (types.ts BuildBase, beside `transformedFrom` at line 175):

```ts
/**
 * Set only by the 2v2 turn and Training: the stored stats (Showdown storedStats) when they are not the build's own, after
 * Power Split, Guard Split, Speed Swap, Power Trick, Power Shift or Transform. HP is never in it. A form change drops it
 * (PS/sim/pokemon.ts setSpecies recomputes storedStats).
 */
storedStats?: Record<"atk" | "def" | "spa" | "spd" | "spe", number>;
```

Readers:
- `makePokemon` (calculate.ts:189-224): after `new Pokemon`, when `build.storedStats` is set, `pokemon.rawStats[stat] =
  pokemon.stats[stat] = storedStats[stat]` for the five stats, with a clone hook as `withTypes` has (calculate.ts:181-187:
  `pokemon.clone = () => withStored(clone(), stats)`), since `Pokemon.clone()` recomputes stats from the species and the spread
  (`@smogon/calc/dist/pokemon.js:95-117`). uses-to-ko.ts copyPokemon (line 4343) copies rawStats and keeps an own `clone`, so
  the pairwise step and its reruns see it. The calculation's Wonder Room swap (`checkRawStatChanges`,
  `@smogon/calc/dist/mechanics/util.js:212-218`) then swaps the override, which is Showdown's order (SA06). Its Power Trick swap
  is never used (the override already holds the swapped stats; the 2v2 never sets `isPowerTrick`).
- `getBuildStats` (model.ts:315-339): returns `{ hp, ...storedStats }` when set. HP of a transformed build comes from
  `transformedFrom.speciesId` (as calculate.ts:699 already reads it).
- Through those two, with no other change: `speedOf`/`turnSpeed` (doubles-turn.ts:701; calculate.ts:3082) and so the gen 8+
  re-sort and the end of turn's Speed order (K10); the memo keys hold the build, so they follow. `confusionRolls`
  (doubles-status.ts:371-386), Strength Sap (1761-1781), Beast Boost (`koBoost`, doubles-turn.ts:1243-1256), Download's Start
  (§3.4.5), Foul Play and Body Press (the calculation's raw stats).

Writers: Power Split, Guard Split, Speed Swap, Power Trick, Power Shift, Transform (§4.2, §4.3). Each writes the full five from
`kernel.buildStats(build)` (the current stored stats, an earlier override included).

Form changes: one helper `withSpecies(build, speciesId)` in doubles-world.ts returns `{ ...build, speciesId, storedStats:
undefined, weighthg: undefined }`; every engine form change uses it: `stanceChange` (doubles-status.ts:948-953), the busted
Disguise and Ice Face (doubles-turn.ts faceHit, 2615-2680; BUSTED_FORMS), the EOT forms (doubles-eot.ts formGuard, hungerSwitch).
A Power Trick or Power Shift volatile stays: Showdown keeps the volatile while setSpecies undoes the swap, and the next toggle
swaps the fresh stats (PS/data/moves.ts:13836-13845); the engine does the same with `vol.powerTrick` (§4.2). Transform's own
species write does not use it (Transform sets the override itself).

### 3.3 Weight: `BattleBuild.weighthg`

`weighthg?: number` (set only by the 2v2 turn and Training): the Pokémon's weight in hectograms when it is not the species'
(Autotomize, Transform). `makePokemon` passes `overrides: { weightkg: weighthg / 10 }` (the calculation's `getWeight` then
applies Heavy Metal, Light Metal and Float Stone on top: `@smogon/calc/dist/mechanics/util.js:541-555`, as Showdown's
ModifyWeight does). A form change drops it (setSpecies sets weighthg = species.weighthg, PS/sim/pokemon.ts:1396). Readers: Low
Kick, Grass Knot, Heavy Slam, Heat Crash into or from the Pokémon (the calculation).

### 3.4 Ability changes

#### 3.4.1 The ability table (generated)

New generated data file `app/lib/battle/ability-table.ts` (generator: a new `ability-table-gen.ts` beside
`../../status-eot/build/track-a-gen-status-table.ts`, from the pinned dex with the mods, per catalog; `census-moves-dex.ts`
already extracts the same lists). Per game, per catalog ability:

```ts
export type AbilityEntry = {
  flags: Partial<Record<"cantsuppress" | "failroleplay" | "failskillswap" | "noentrain" | "notrace" | "notransform" | "breakable", true>>;
  /** Which handlers exist (PS data/abilities.ts with the game's mods): Start runs when the ability is gained mid-turn; SwitchIn does not. */
  start?: true; switchIn?: true; end?: true; update?: true;
};
export const ABILITY_TABLE: Readonly<Record<BattleGame, Readonly<Record<string, AbilityEntry>>>>;
```

The per-game lists differ (census-moves-dex.out): failskillswap SV 23, Champions 6, SwSh 14, USUM 12; failroleplay SV 27,
Champions 10, SwSh 18, USUM 18; notransform SV 13, Champions 3, SwSh 5, USUM 1. `imposter.ts` NO_TRACE_ABILITIES and
NO_TRANSFORM_ABILITIES (imposter.ts:4-21) stay for the 1v1 but are checked against the table by a source test (they must equal
SV's notrace / notransform lists, or the test names the difference).

#### 3.4.2 The helper

New file `app/lib/battle/doubles-abilities.ts` (hooks module, like doubles-items.ts; imports only the TurnKernel type):

```ts
/** One ability change on `slot` (PS/sim/pokemon.ts:1908-1946 setAbility; PS/sim/battle.ts:1311-1345 skillSwap). Returns the worlds. */
export function setAbility(kernel: TurnKernel, w: World, slot: DoublesSlotId, ability: string,
  opts: { source: DoublesSlotId; how: "skillswap" | "roleplay" | "entrainment" | "simplebeam" | "worryseed" | "doodle" | "transform" | "trace";
    use?: Use; start?: boolean /* Skill Swap runs both Ends first, then both Starts */ }): World[];
/** Skill Swap's own order: both SetAbility checks, both Ends, the swap, both fresh states, target's Start, then the user's. */
export function skillSwap(kernel: TurnKernel, w: World, user: DoublesSlotId, target: DoublesSlotId, use: Use): World[];
```

Steps, Showdown's order:
1. **Checks** (the move's own onTryHit, §4.4) are the caller's; `setAbility` itself checks cantsuppress on the old and new ability
   (skipped for Transform, which calls it with `isFromFormeChange`: PS/sim/pokemon.ts:1916-1918, 1352) and the SetAbility event:
   a working Ability Shield blocks (`Ability Shield: {Name} keeps {Ability}.`, kind "blocked"; SA14e), not for Transform.
2. **End of the old ability** (§3.4.4), even when suppressed (End runs under gas: PS/sim/battle.ts singleEvent).
3. **The switch**: `build.abilityId = ability`, `tracedAbility`, `settledDownload`, `settledBoostedStat`, `copiedIntimidateStored`
   cleared, `abilityActive = freshActive(ability)` (§3.4.3), `abilityChanged: true` (§3.4.8).
4. **Start of the new ability** (§3.4.5) unless the new one has no Start handler in this game (the table), it is suppressed
   (`build.abilityId` would read the gas stand-in: see §3.4.9), or Transform copied the same ability.
5. The action's **Update** (doubles-status.ts updateAll, 1992-2043) then cures what the new ability cures (SA14f): extend its
   own-cure check from "a status this action gave" to "a status this action gave, or one whose holder's ability changed this
   action" (`Before` gains the ability), the same for Own Tempo's confusion and Oblivious's Taunt.

Everything that reads `build.abilityId` per world then follows: the calculations, `MOLD_BREAKERS`, redirection, the absorbing
abilities, `turnUnnerve`, `effectiveWeather`, partner abilities in `conditionsFor` (Friend Guard, Battery, Power Spot, Steely
Spirit, Plus/Minus via calcBuild, Flower Gift), `grounded` (Levitate: K5, K7), `priorityOf` (gen 8+: SA14; gen 7's frozen
priorities keep the turn start: SA14 usum), `speedOf` (Swift Swim, Unburden...), the residuals (doubles-eot.ts collect reads
each world's ability: K9b), `berryArithmetic` (Gluttony), `canStatus` (Insomnia, Limber...).

#### 3.4.3 The fresh ability state

Showdown gives the new ability a fresh `abilityState` (PS/sim/pokemon.ts:1924-1925). The engine's equivalent is `abilityActive`:
`defaultAbilityActive(ability)` (model.ts:253: Slow Start, Protean, Libero, Imposter, Intrepid Sword, Dauntless Shield true),
false for everything else: Flash Fire (its `flashfire` volatile ended with the old holder's End: SA14c), Unburden (its volatile
too), Stakeout, Analytic. Plus and Minus are recomputed by `calcBuild` (doubles-turn.ts:444-450). Electromorphosis: its charge
is the Pokémon's `charge` volatile, not the ability's state. The turn sets a mid-turn charge on `MonState.charged`
(doubles-turn.ts:2126); an input build's Electromorphosis `abilityActive` (model.ts:60, "Electromorphosis is charged") is the
same volatile, so the helper moves it to `MonState.charged` before the switch and the new holder starts uncharged.

#### 3.4.4 Ends

| Old ability | End (PS/data/abilities.ts) | Model |

| Unnerve, As One | berries no longer stopped | `kernel.unnerveEnds(w, [slot])` (doubles-turn.ts:1756) runs the Berries now due at this action's Update (SA16) |
| Air Lock, Cloud Nine | weather acts again | automatic (`effectiveWeather` reads living holders); `fieldGuard` on a weather change (§3.4.6) |
| Flash Fire, Unburden, Slow Start | volatile removed | step 3's `abilityActive` reset |
| Desolate Land, Primordial Sea, Delta Stream (USUM) | strong weather ends unless another holder | as `faint` does (doubles-turn.ts:1232-1235), then the weather-change rule |
| Protosynthesis, Quark Drive | boost volatile removed | `settledBoostedStat` cleared (only Gastro Acid reaches them: SV's failskillswap/failroleplay/noentrain lists hold them) |
| Neutralizing Gas | gas ends | `kernel.gasEnds(w, slot)` (doubles-turn.ts:1196): its existing guard |
| Zen Mode, Illusion, Gorilla Tactics, Opportunist, Supreme Overlord | form, disguise, lock, copy | Zen Mode, Illusion: cantsuppress/failskillswap in their games, so only Gastro Acid reaches them where allowed → `REASONS.abilityEnd`; Gorilla Tactics, Opportunist, Supreme Overlord: nothing left this turn (the ability's effect is read per world) |

Every row's generation gating is the ability table's (a Start missing in a game is not run there).

#### 3.4.6 Weather and terrain changes from abilities

A Start or End that changes the weather or terrain (setters, Air Lock/Cloud Nine, strong weather ending, Utility Umbrella by
Klutz) runs `fieldGuard` (doubles-status.ts:928-946): a living Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Forecast, Mimicry, Flower Gift, Ice
Face holder or a Seed/Booster Energy is `A weather or terrain change this turn would change {Name}.` (existing text). For Air
Lock/Cloud Nine the "change" is the effective weather (sun on or off for Protosynthesis): the guard runs when `effectiveWeather`
changes value.

#### 3.4.7 Intimidate mid-turn

`intimidateStart(kernel, w, holder, use)`: for each living foe of the holder, by Showdown position (opponent-right is position 0:
doubles-types.ts SHOWDOWN_POSITION; the order matters for Mirror Armor's two reflections and for Eject Pack): Substitute → step
fact `{Name} is behind a Substitute.`; otherwise `applyBoosts(kernel, w, foe, { atk: -1 }, holder, { use, effect: "ability",
intimidate: true, report: true })`. `applyBoosts` gains an `intimidate` option for the Intimidate-only TryBoost and AfterBoost
handlers, gen-gated by the ability table (their handlers are missing in USUM: SA27; PS/data/mods/gen7/abilities.ts:34-81):
- Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, Scrappy (gen 8+): the Attack drop is removed, `{Ability}: its Attack is not lowered.`
- Guard Dog (SV): the drop is removed and it boosts itself +1 Atk (`Guard Dog: +1 Attack.`; a rise: World.boosted).
- Rattled (gen 8+): after the drop, +1 Spe (`Rattled: +1 Speed.`).
- Adrenaline Orb (SV, SwSh, USUM): after the boost, unless Atk was already at −6 (+6 with Contrary) or the drop was blocked to 0:
  used, +1 Spe (`Adrenaline Orb: +1 Speed.`), Unburden; PS/data/items.ts:111-135.
- the rest as any foe's drop: Clear Amulet, Clear Body, White Smoke, Hyper Cutter, Full Metal Body, Flower Veil, Mirror Armor
  (back to the holder), Defiant, Competitive, White Herb, Eject Pack (World.boosted fell → the existing switch-out guard).

#### 3.4.8 Validation of a changed ability

`BattleBuild.abilityChanged?: true` (set only by the 2v2 turn and Training): the ability is not the species' own (Skill Swap,
Role Play, Entrainment, Simple Beam, Worry Seed, Doodle). `validateBuild` (model.ts:382-387) then accepts any ability of the
catalog that is not `unsupported`. The calculator UI never sets it (no control, §10.4). Training sets it from the belief battle
(§8), and `evaluate.ts foreignAbility` (lines 138-147) skips builds with it.

#### 3.4.9 Gastro Acid and the gas

Gastro Acid makes one Pokémon's ability inert: `build.abilityId = GAS_STAND_IN` ("runaway", calculate.ts:968) with
`vol.gastroAcid = <the real ability>`. Every read then sees no ability, as for Neutralizing Gas; `outcomeOf` puts the real one
back with the volatile `gastroacid` (as it does from `gas.abilities` today, doubles-turn.ts:3554-3559). The volatile belongs to
the Pokémon, not the ability (PS/sim/pokemon.ts:864 ignoringAbility reads `volatiles['gastroacid']`): a Gastro Acid holder that
gets a new ability keeps it suppressed (`vol.gastroAcid` takes the new id, the stand-in stays; no Start: singleEvent skips it),
the flag checks of Skill Swap, Role Play, Entrainment and Doodle read the real ability (`getAbility()`), the other party of a
Skill Swap gets the real ability unsuppressed, and Transform onto it copies the real ability.

The eight moves under Neutralizing Gas from the turn's start keep `REASONS.withGas` in phases 1-5. Phase 6 (optional, §15)
lifts it for them: the gas's stand-ins become per world (`MonState.gassed?: string`, set in startWorld from
`settle.gas.abilities`), an ability change on a suppressed Pokémon changes `gassed` and runs only the End (Start is skipped
under suppression), the failskillswap/failroleplay/noentrain flags of Neutralizing Gas stop the moves on its holder, Gastro Acid
on a holder ends the gas (the existing `gasEnds` guard), and Transform onto a holder copies an inert Neutralizing Gas
(notransform). The thirteen NG oracle cases (`../../ngas-pp/fix/cases-ng.ts`) are its regression.

### 3.5 The transformed build

`transformBuild(kernel, w, user, target): BattleBuild` (doubles-abilities.ts):

```ts
{
  ...targetBuild,                       // species (its current form), boosts, nature, spread are the target's...
  // ...but these are the user's own (PS/sim/pokemon.ts:1270-1380 copies only what it names):
  game, native: { ...user.native, level: user.native.level } | points: user.points,   // HP training and level (SA19d)
  itemId: user.itemId, status: user.status, mechanic: user.mechanic, currentHP: null,
  configuration: { ...target.configuration, gender: user gender, happiness: user's, hiddenPowerType: user's, teraType: user's },
  transformedFrom: { speciesId: user's own species, baseHP: user's own base HP },
  storedStats: kernel.buildStats(targetBuild) minus hp,   // copied as they are: an earlier split or Speed Swap included
  weighthg: target's weight (its override or the species'),
  boosts: target's five; vol.stages: target's accuracy and evasion,
  focusEnergy / dragonCheer: the target's (settledFocusEnergy counts as focusenergy), the user's own removed first,
  abilityId: per setAbility(…, how: "transform"): the target's real one (vol.gastroAcid ?? abilityId); inert when notransform (the table)
             or TRANSFORM_LOCKED_ABILITIES; a Gastro Acid on the user stays and suppresses it,
  tracedAbility, settledDownload, settledBoostedStat, settledCustap, firstTurnSpeed, pendingCopy: undefined,
}
```

- Types: the species' types (pre-Tera: SA19e); a target that is Roosted copies its types with Flying (`typeWas`); a target whose
  type changed this turn (FAMILY 2's per-world types) copies that type: until FAMILY 2's field exists, `REASONS.transformTyped`.
- HP: the user's (ctx.hp is fixed for the turn; makePokemon's `transformedFrom.baseHP` override gives the same maximum).
- Failures (PS/sim/pokemon.ts:1271-1281), each a hit fact `Transform fails: {reason}.`: the target fainted; the user or target
  has an Illusion; the target is behind a Substitute (SA19b: the existing Substitute check in hitOne gives `{Name} is behind a
  Substitute.`, kind no-damage, which is the same outcome); the target or the user is transformed; Eternatus-Eternamax; Ogerpon
  or Terapagos with either Terastallized; the user Terastallized as Stellar. SwSh: a Dynamaxed target → `REASONS.transformMax`.
- The ability's Start runs only when it differs from the user's (PS/sim/pokemon.ts:1941-1943): Intimidate drops the foes (SA19).
- The moves (the target's, 5 PP each) matter only after this turn: E2 and Training (§8, §9).

## 4. The moves

Each entry: kind and table keys; the model (hook, line); failures and their facts; randomness; end of turn; E2; Training;
reasons left. "Hit fact" is on the reached Pokémon's DoublesHit; "step fact" on the action (doubles-status.ts aboutSlot names the
Pokémon). Stage facts are applyBoosts' existing `+2 Attack.`, `−1 Defense.`, `Its Attack cannot go higher.`.

### 4.1 Stat stages

**Acupressure** (M; `handler: "acupressure"`; all four games). Targets: doubles-status.ts targetsOf `adjacentAllyOrSelf` (1036-1046,
exists). No protect flag (passes Protect), no bypasssub (an ally's Substitute blocks it: K19, hitOne's check at 1329). onHit:
the stages below +6 (all seven, `vol.stages` for accuracy and evasion) in Showdown's order atk, def, spa, spd, spe, accuracy,
evasion; none → hit fact `Acupressure fails: {Name}'s stats are all at +6.`; else one world per stat, mass 1/n (`cloneWorld(w,
w.mass / n)`), each `applyBoosts(…, { [stat]: 2 }, user, { use, effect: "move", report: true })` (Contrary −2, Simple +4; SA02b).
The Speed world re-sorts from generation 8 by itself (SA01). Worlds do not merge across the picked stat (their builds differ);
budget ×7 at most. End of turn: nothing. E2: the stage (accuracy and evasion in `stages`, §9). Training: maps (public -boost).

**Psych Up** (M; `psychUp`; all four). Target normal, bypasssub, no protect flag (SA03, SA03b). onHit: `writeStages(user, all
seven of the target's)`; the user's crit volatiles replaced by the target's (`focusEnergy` from the target's focusEnergy or
settledFocusEnergy; `dragonCheer` the target's value, which already holds its hasDragonType; the user's `settledFocusEnergy`
cleared); then White Herb (SA03). Step facts: `{User} copies {Target}'s stat changes.`; with crit stages copied or lost,
`{User}'s critical-hit stages are now {Target}'s.`. G-Max Chi Strike and Laser Focus are never set in a world (G-Max Chi Strike is
a "later" guard, GMAX_EFFECTS; Laser Focus is kind N) so nothing else is copied. End of turn: nothing. E2: stages. No reason left.

**Power Swap / Guard Swap / Heart Swap** (M; `swapStages` with `stats: ["atk","spa"] | ["def","spd"] | all seven`; Heart Swap in SV
and USUM only). protect + bypasssub (SA04 blocked by Protect; a Substitute does not stop them). onHit: `writeStages` on both with
the other's values; White Herb on each (SA04b); no Eject Pack (SA04c), no Opportunist. Step fact: `{User} and {Target} swap their
Attack and Sp. Atk changes.` / `… their Defense and Sp. Def changes.` / `… their stat changes.`. A later hit reads them (SA04d).

**Topsy-Turvy** (M; `topsyTurvy`; all four). protect, reflectable (Magic Bounce and Magic Coat send it back: the bounce path).
onHit: every nonzero stage negated by `writeStages`; none nonzero → `Topsy-Turvy fails: {Name} has no stat changes.`; White Herb
(SA08); no Defiant, no Eject Pack (K14). Hit fact: `Its stat changes are inverted.`.

**Stockpile** (C: exact with the carried layers; `stockpile`, `fails: "stockpile"`; all four). Self, snatch. moveTry: three layers
→ `Stockpile fails: {Name} has stockpiled 3 times.` (SA09). effects: `applyBoosts(self, {def: 1, spd: 1}, self, report)`, then
`vol.stockpile = { layers: n + 1, def: def + (Def changed ? 1 : 0), spd: … }` from the stages before and after (SA09b: at +6
only SpD counts; SA09c: Contrary counts its −1). Hit fact `Stockpile {n}.`. The carried layers: `DoublesCarried.stockpile`
(§9, §10.4); absent: none, with the turn fact `Assumes {Name} has not stockpiled.` when its move is Stockpile, Swallow or Spit Up.
End of turn: nothing. E2: `stockpile` and the volatile id `stockpile`. Training: tracker.ts already keeps the layers
(`-start|…|stockpileN`, lines 780-783); the counters come from the `-boost|…|def|0` lines it already sees (§8).

**Swallow** (C; `swallow`, `fails: "stockpile"`; all four; lifted from HP_STATUS_MOVES). Self, snatch, heal (Triage +3 exists in
turnPriority). moveTry: no Stockpile → `Swallow fails: {Name} has not stockpiled.` (a snatched Swallow skips it and heals by 1 layer:
PS/data/moves.ts:18584 and 18588, FAMILY 3's Snatch). onHit: `healWorlds(modify(maxhp, [0.25, 0.5, 1][layers − 1]))` (Heal Block
and full HP fail it, as today), then **whatever the heal did**, the Stockpile ends (PS/data/moves.ts:18590-18592): its End
`applyBoosts(self, { def: −counted, spd: −counted }, self)` (Contrary inverts: SA09c; White Herb; Eject Pack → the switch-out
guard), `vol.stockpile` removed. Hit facts: the heal (`Swallow: +59 HP.` in heals), `Stockpile ends.`, the stage facts.

**Spit Up** (damaging; C). damagingMove (doubles-turn.ts:1788): Try (`return !!source.volatiles['stockpile']`) → with no
Stockpile, step fact `Spit Up fails: {Name} has not stockpiled.` and no hit; else the calculation with `MoveContext.stockpile =
layers` (calculate.ts: Spit Up's HISTORY_MOVES entry at line 60 is skipped when the context has it, and basePower is 100 × layers,
as resolve-move.ts overrides Return's: SA09 300 power). AfterMove (onAfterMove, after the hits): the Stockpile End as Swallow's
(step facts `{Name}'s Stockpile ends.` and its stage facts). The 1v1 never sets the context: byte-equal.

**Stuff Cheeks** (M; `stuffCheeks`, `fails: "berry"`; SV, Champions, SwSh; lifted from HP_STATUS_MOVES). moveTry: no Berry →
`Stuff Cheeks fails: {Name} holds no Berry.` onHit: `applyBoosts(self, {def: 2})`; nothing changed (+6) → `Stuff Cheeks fails:
{Name}'s Defense cannot go higher.` and the Berry stays (SA10); else the forced eat at any HP: Bug Bite's path
(`kernel.ateBerry`, `berryArithmetic`, `pouchHeal`: doubles-turn.ts:1687), with no TryEatItem (Unnerve does not stop it: SA10b)
and no effect for an Embargoed/Magic Room/Klutz holder (singleEvent skips a suppressed item's Eat: the Berry is gone with no
heal). Starf's random rise branches as today. E2: the item gone; FAMILY 3's `lastItem` when it lands.

**Tidy Up** (M; `tidyUp`; SV, Champions). onHit: every active Pokémon's `vol.substitute` deleted (K24); every side's hazards gone
(`SideState.hazards = []` and `hazardsCleared: true`, §9); then `applyBoosts(self, {atk: 1, spe: 1}, self)`. Step facts:
`Tidy Up: {Name}'s Substitute is removed.` per Substitute removed; `Tidy Up: the hazards are removed from both sides.` only when a
hazard landed earlier this turn (hazards from before the turn are not an input). E2: `hazardsCleared` on both sides (Training's
nextClock zeroes the side's hazard clock before adding this turn's later ones: §8).

**No Retreat** (C: exact with the carried volatile; `fails: "noRetreat"`, `volatile: "noretreat"`; SV, Champions, SwSh). moveTry:
`vol.noRetreat` → `No Retreat fails: it is already up on {Name}.` (SA12). effects: boosts +1 all five (table), then the volatile
unless the user is already trapped (PS/data/moves.ts:12800-12802). "Trapped" is the `trapped` volatile, not partial trapping
(EotState.trap): Block, Mean Look and Spider Web (kind N today: they gain a handler that sets `vol.trapped` on a target that is
not a Ghost type, gen 6+) and the hits of Jaw Lock (both Pokémon), Anchor Shot, Spirit Shackle and Thousand Waves (afterHit, with
the secondaries' Sheer Force, Shield Dust and Covert Cloak rules) set it this turn; `DoublesCarried.trapped` carries one from an
earlier turn (Training maps the `trapped` volatile it ignores today; the calculator: none). It is read by No Retreat alone. Hit
fact `{Name} can no longer switch out.` when the volatile is added. Carried: `DoublesCarried.noRetreat`; absent: `Assumes {Name} has not used No Retreat.` when
its move is No Retreat. E2 volatile `noretreat`.

**Autotomize** (M; `autotomize`, `fails: "autotomize"`; SwSh, USUM). moveTry (its onTryHit): Speed +6 (−6 with an unbroken
Contrary) → `Autotomize fails: {Name}'s Speed cannot go higher.` effects: boosts Spe +2; onHit: weighthg > 1 → `weighthg =
max(1, weighthg − 1000)` (§3.3; K18). Hit fact `Autotomize: {Name} weighs {kg} kg.` (one decimal). E2: the build's weighthg.
Training: Champions has no Autotomize.

**Minimize** (M; `volatile: "minimize"`; all four). Self, snatch. effects: evasion +2 (table boosts), `vol.minimize = true` (a
second use restarts nothing: onRestart null; the evasion still rises). The ×2: `engine-corrections.cjs` wraps
`util.chainMods` for the final chain only (its bounds 41 and 131072: `@smogon/calc/dist/mechanics/gen789.js:481, 531`,
`champions.js:273, 318`; the stat chains use 410) inside a run calculate.ts opens when the defender build has `minimized` (a
build field the 2v2's calcBuild sets from `vol.minimize`) and the move used is a minimize-flag move (a generated
`MINIMIZE_MOVES` from the dex: Body Slam, Dragon Rush, Flying Press, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Malicious Moonsault, Steamroller,
Stomp, Supercell Slam; the Z-Move or Max Move used is never one), appending 8192 to that chain, as `withPowerMods` does for the
base-power chain (engine-corrections.cjs:107). Each hit of a multi-hit chain (line 531) gets it too. SA13's 16 rolls are the
check. Every move hits already (onAccuracy). Later hits into it get the hit fact `Minimize: double damage.`; condition fact
`Minimized.`. Carried: `DoublesCarried.minimize` (Training: the `minimize` volatile); the calculator has no control and states
`Assumes {Name} has not used Minimize.` when a minimize-flag move can reach it (§10.2). E2 volatile `minimize`.

**Geomancy** (C; `geomancy`; SwSh, USUM). A charge move: with a working Power Herb (PS/data/items.ts:4771-4787) the herb is used
(item gone, Unburden; Symbiosis: the existing eventGuards) and the boosts +2 SpA/SpD/Spe apply now (K21); without, the charge
turn: no boosts, `vol.charging = "geomancy"`, step fact `{Name} charges Geomancy.`. The release (the move used after a charge last
turn): `DoublesCarried.charging = "geomancy"`, which skips the charge (Training: the twoturnmove volatile; the calculator:
`Assumes {Name} did not charge Geomancy last turn.`). E2 volatiles `twoturnmove` and `geomancy` (Showdown adds both). Training: neither game is Champions.

**Gear Up / Magnetic Flux** (M; `plusMinus` with `{atk:1,spa:1}` / `{def:1,spd:1}`; Gear Up SwSh, USUM; Magnetic Flux all four).
allySide → sideOrField (doubles-status.ts:1834): the living Pokémon of the user's side by Showdown position whose ability is Plus
or Minus (not suppressed: the stand-in reads otherwise), each `applyBoosts(…, user, { effect: "move", report })` with
`use.reached` (hit entries); none → `{Move} fails: no Pokémon on {Name}'s side has Plus or Minus.`. A Dynamaxed Pokémon's Max
Guard is a presence guard already (REASONS.maxGuard), so no world has one.

**Flower Shield** (M; `flowerShield`; SwSh, USUM). target all → sideOrField: every active Grass type (kernel.typesOf: Tera
included) in Showdown's getAllActive order (side p1 then p2, by position), `applyBoosts({def: 1}, user)` (a foe's Contrary: a drop
from a foe → Clear Body, Defiant...); none → `Flower Shield fails: no Grass type is in play.` (K22).

**Rototiller** (M; `rototiller`; USUM). target all: each active Pokémon that fails Ground immunity (`!kernel.grounded`) is
`{Name} is immune.`; each grounded Grass type gets `{atk: 1, spa: 1}` from the user; no grounded Grass type and no airborne one →
`Rototiller fails: no grounded Grass type is in play.` (PS/data/moves.ts:15475-15493; K23).

### 4.2 Stored stats

**Power Split / Guard Split** (M; `splitStats` with `["atk","spa"]` / `["def","spd"]`; all four). protect, no bypasssub (a Substitute
blocks them). onHit: for each stat, `floor((a + b) / 2)` from `kernel.buildStats` of both; both builds get `storedStats` (§3.2).
Step fact: `{User} and {Target} now have {atk} Attack and {spa} Sp. Atk.` / `… {def} Defense and {spd} Sp. Def.` (K12, K12b,
SA06, SA06b). A Dynamaxed party: the stored stats are not HP: no special case.

**Speed Swap** (M; `speedSwap`; all four). protect, bypasssub. Swap the stored Speed (K10). Step fact `{User} now has {x} Speed,
{Target} {y}.`. Order: gen 8+ re-sorts (automatic), USUM frozen (automatic).

**Power Trick / Power Shift** (C: exact with the carried volatile; `powerTrick` with the volatile id; Power Trick all four, Power
Shift Champions only and no Champions learner). Self, snatch. With no `vol.powerTrick` (`vol.powerShift`): swap stored Atk and Def,
set the volatile, hit fact `Power Trick: {Name}'s Attack is {x} and its Defense {y}.` (SA07, SA07b, K11). With it: remove the
volatile and swap back (onRestart → End: SA07), hit fact `Power Trick ends: {Name}'s Attack is {x} and its Defense {y}.`.
Carried: `DoublesCarried.powerTrick` / `powerShift` (true), applied in carriedState as the swap of the start build's stored stats;
absent: `Assumes {Name} has no Power Trick from an earlier turn.` when its move is Power Trick. E2: the build's storedStats and the
volatile id. A form change keeps the volatile and drops the override (§3.2), as Showdown does.

### 4.3 Transform and Imposter

**Transform** (C; `transform`; all four). Target normal, no protect flag (passes Protect), no bypasssub. onHit: the failures of
§3.5, then `transformBuild` and `setAbility(user, target's ability, { how: "transform" })` (its Start when it differs: SA19).
Step fact `{User} transforms into {Target}.`. Then every later step reads the transformed build: hits into it (its copied types,
stats, ability, stages: K13, SA19), its weight (SA19c), its Speed (re-sort, end of turn), its ability's residual. Condition fact
`Transformed into {Target}.`. E2: the transformed build (species, storedStats, weighthg, transformedFrom, abilityId) and the
volatile id `transform`; `DoublesOutcomeMon.moves` = the target's move ids (§9). Reasons left: `REASONS.transformTyped`,
`REASONS.transformMax` (§12).

**Imposter** (settle). `settleDoublesStart` (calculate.ts:3189-3191) no longer fails on Imposter: the slot's Phase-1 needs gain the
foe across (`needs.push([across(slot)])`, PS/data/abilities.ts:2115-2128 copies `foe.active[length − 1 − position]`: census-probes
P5), and `settleAbilities` (calculate.ts:486-542) transforms it into that foe with the 1v1's rules (the target's species, stats but
HP, ability, stages with the target's entry boosts, types, moves; its own item, status, HP; inert notransform abilities) and its
withheld texts (Tera or Dynamax on either; two levels; two game rules). Its folded build gets `transformedFrom` as in the 1v1, so
the turn then runs a transformed Pokémon exactly as after Transform. Not under Neutralizing Gas (the stand-in: NG26 unchanged)
and not into another Imposter. With the slot across empty (its Pokémon fainted with no replacement: the input is null) what it
copied is not known: `REASONS.imposterAcross`. Turn fact: `Assumes {Imposter} transformed into {Target} as both entered.` (the 1v1 line's
assumption, in names). PRESENCE_THIRD_PARTY keeps "imposter" only for the guard's documentation (doubles-turn.ts:786 already skips
it). Training: the belief battle's transformed Ditto is passed as such (§8).

### 4.4 Abilities

All seven go through §3.4. Failures are hit facts (`{Move} fails: {reason}.`) from hitOne's single-target onTryHit block
(doubles-status.ts:1318-1327), checked in Showdown's order; a reflectable move (Entrainment, Simple Beam, Worry Seed, Gastro Acid)
can be bounced (the existing bounce path) and its holder is then the user.

**Skill Swap** (C; `skillSwap`; all four). protect, bypasssub. Fails: either party fainted; either Dynamaxed (SwSh); either ability
failskillswap (the table, per game) → `Skill Swap fails: {Name}'s {Ability} cannot be swapped.`; generation ≤ 5's same-ability
rule does not apply here. SetAbility: Ability Shield on the target, then on the user (SA14e). Then both Ends, the swap, both fresh
states, the target's Start, the user's (PS/sim/battle.ts:1333-1344; two Intimidates both act). Step fact: between foes `{User}
gets {B}; {Target} gets {A}.`; between allies the same text (the UI knows both sides; Showdown's hidden line is Training's
concern only, §8). SA14 (priority), SA14b (Trace), SA14c (Flash Fire), SA14f (Insomnia), SA21 (Download), K5, Q2.

**Role Play** (C; `rolePlay`). bypasssub, no protect flag (SA15). Fails: same ability `Role Play fails: {User} already has {A}.`;
the target's failroleplay `… {Target}'s {A} cannot be copied.`; the user's cantsuppress `… {User}'s {A} cannot be replaced.`.
`setAbility(user, target's)`. Step fact `{User} gets {A}.`. K9b (Speed Boost at the end of turn), SA15.

**Entrainment** (C; `entrainment`). protect, reflectable. Fails: into itself; the target Dynamaxed (SwSh); same ability; the target's
cantsuppress or Truant; the user's noentrain. `setAbility(target, user's)`; Ability Shield on the target blocks. K6, SA27.

**Simple Beam** (C; `simpleBeam`). protect, reflectable. Fails: the target's cantsuppress, Simple, Truant. `setAbility(target,
"simple")` (no Start; the End: SA16's Unnerve). Later boosts on it double through applyBoosts (K8).

**Worry Seed** (C; `worrySeed`). protect, reflectable. TryImmunity (doubles-status.ts tryImmunity, 1298): Truant or Insomnia →
`{Name} is immune.`; TryHit: cantsuppress. `setAbility(target, "insomnia")`, then a sleeping target is cured (`cureStatus`: Q2b,
the target then moves; K9c a later Spore fails through canStatus).

**Gastro Acid** (C; `gastroAcid`, `volatile: "gastroacid"`). protect, reflectable. Fails: cantsuppress; Ability Shield (`Ability
Shield: {Name} keeps {A}.`, blocked); already suppressed (`Gastro Acid fails: it is already up on {Name}.`). Then the End of its
ability (§3.4.4) and the stand-in (§3.4.9). Hit fact `Its {A} is suppressed.`. K7, SA17. Carried: `DoublesCarried.gastroAcid`
(Training: the `-endability` volatile; tracker.ts:727 keeps it); the calculator: no control (§10.4).

**Doodle** (C; `doodle`; SV only). adjacentFoe, no protect flag, no bypasssub (a Substitute blocks it). Fails: the target's
failroleplay. Then for the user and its ally (alliesAndSelf, by position), each not already with it and not cantsuppress:
`setAbility(…, target's ability)` with its Start (K9: two Intimidates). Step facts per Pokémon.

## 5. Interactions with the other families

- **FAMILY 2 (types and volatiles)**: Transform copies the target's current types; FAMILY 2's per-world types field is what it
  copies (§3.5). Until it exists, a target with a changed type is `REASONS.transformTyped`. FAMILY 2's Captivate and Tar Shot use
  applyBoosts (§3.1) unchanged; its Attract gender reads `getBuildGender` (a transformed Pokémon keeps its own gender).
- **FAMILY 3 (field, side, reflection, items)**: Snatch re-runs our snatchable moves with another user (Stockpile, Swallow, Stuff
  Cheeks, No Retreat, Autotomize, Minimize, Power Trick, Power Shift, Gear Up, Magnetic Flux): every handler here reads `use.user`,
  never `action.slot`, and the table's new `snatch` flag marks them. A snatched Swallow heals a quarter with no Stockpile and does
  not end the original user's (PS/data/moves.ts:18584-18592). Magic Coat bounces Topsy-Turvy, Entrainment, Simple Beam, Worry Seed
  and Gastro Acid through the bounce path. Recycle and Harvest read the Berry Stuff Cheeks ate (FAMILY 3's lastItem). Tidy Up and
  Defog/Court Change share `hazardsCleared` (§9).
- **FAMILY 4 (guards)**: the copies-rise guard (Opportunist, Mirror Herb) reads World.boosted, which every boost() here feeds and
  no direct write does (§3.1); the hidden-stages fix makes SAT-ACU-2 ready; the switch-out family covers Eject Pack after an
  Intimidate drop or a Stockpile End. The Trace-curing bug (census-guards.md "trace-curing-ability") uses the same effective
  ability as this family: in the turn the world build already holds the traced ability (calculate.ts:474-476); the bug is in the
  input-level reads (turnFacts, the UI's START_CURES), which FAMILY 4 fixes.
- **Neutralizing Gas** (ngas-pp's NG cases): §3.4.9.

## 6. Randomness and branch weights

| Event | Showdown call | Branches |
|---|---|---|
| Acupressure | `this.sample(stats below +6)` | n worlds, 1/n each (SA01, SA02b) |
| Trace gained (Skill Swap; Transform onto a Pokémon whose Trace copied nothing, since Trace has no notransform flag) | `this.sample(adjacent foes with copyable abilities)` | k worlds, 1/k (SA14b) |
| Speed ties after a Speed change | `prng.shuffle` | existing |
| Stuff Cheeks' Starf Berry | `sample` | existing (ateBerry) |
| Worry Seed on a sleeper | removes the later sleep branch | none new |

Nothing else here is random. No branch is approximated; worlds merge only on equal discrete keys (doubles-world.ts:449).

## 7. The end of turn

No move here adds a residual. What they change, the residual phase reads per world already: abilities (collect,
doubles-eot.ts:444-514: Speed Boost after Role Play K9b, Moody's E2 guard, Harvest/Pickup guards, Bad Dreams, Healer, Hydration,
Shed Skin; a Gastro Acid stand-in has none), types (`residualMon`, 377: a transformed Pokémon in sand), Speed (the residual order:
stored Speed overrides through speedOf), Heal Block (Swallow is not a residual), items (Stuff Cheeks' Berry gone). The end-of-turn
guard `w.endGuard = REASONS.notModelled(move)` (doubles-status.ts:785) no longer fires for these moves. White Herb's residual
(doubles-eot.ts:977) and Eject Pack's (989) see the direct writes' stages as start stages for the end of turn (no event this turn
is lost: White Herb already acted at AfterMove).

## 8. Training

Champions only. Family moves with a Champions learner (census-moves.md): Acupressure, Psych Up, Power Swap, Guard Swap, Speed Swap,
Power Split, Guard Split, Power Trick, Topsy-Turvy, Stockpile, Swallow, Stuff Cheeks, Tidy Up, No Retreat, Minimize, Magnetic Flux,
Skill Swap, Role Play, Entrainment, Simple Beam, Worry Seed, Gastro Acid, Transform; Imposter (Ditto).

The next turn's engine input comes from the belief battle (bridge.ts liveBuild, carriedOf): Showdown's own state in that belief
world. Public-information rule: counters Showdown keeps hidden (sleep's and confusion's remaining turns) are read from the public
log (tracker.ts counts); everything here is either public or a deterministic function of public moves and the belief world's sets
(the same footing as `pokemon.set.evs`, which liveBuild already reads):

| State | Source | Public? |
|---|---|---|
| Stockpile layers | tracker.ts `stockpile` volatile layers (`-start|…|stockpileN`, lines 780-783) | yes |
| Stockpile counters | tracker: count each `-boost|…|def|n` / `spd` line of the Stockpile use (n 0 → not counted; Contrary's `-unboost` counts) | yes |
| Power Trick, Power Shift, No Retreat, Minimize, Gastro Acid | the `-start`/`-endability` lines (tracker volatiles) | yes |
| Stored stats after a split, Speed Swap or Power Trick | the belief battle's `mon.storedStats` (the moves' `-activate` lines are public; the values follow from the belief sets) | belief-world |
| Weight | `mon.weighthg` (no Champions move changes it but Transform) | belief-world |
| A changed ability | `mon.ability`; between foes the `-activate|…|Skill Swap|A|B` line is public; between the player's allies Showdown hides it (PS/sim/battle.ts:1325-1332) and the belief battle swaps its sampled abilities | belief-world |
| Transformed | `-transform` (tracker `transformedInto`, line 595) and the belief battle's copy | yes / belief-world |
| Accuracy and evasion stages | `mon.boosts.accuracy`, `.evasion` (public `-boost` lines) | yes |

bridge.ts changes: MAPPED_VOLATILES (lines 38-41) += `stockpile`, `powertrick`, `powershift`, `noretreat`, `minimize`,
`gastroacid`, and `trapped` moves there from IGNORED_VOLATILES (lines 32-36); carriedOf maps them (`stockpile` from the public view's layers and counters, the rest as flags);
liveBuild (59-87) sets `storedStats` when `mon.storedStats` differs from `getBuildStats(base)` (and for a transformed Pokémon),
`weighthg` when it differs from the species', `abilityChanged` when the ability is not the species' own (replacing the
`its ability was changed` rollout), the transformed build (species `mon.species.id`, `transformedFrom` from `mon.baseSpecies` and
the set's HP, `storedStats`, the copied ability, `moves` from `mon.moveSlots`) replacing the `{Name} is transformed.` rollout,
and `carried.stages` for accuracy and evasion. `evaluate.ts foreignAbility` (138-147) skips `abilityChanged` builds. The leak
gate (`npm run leak:training`) must stay at 0 differences; the Stockpile layers and counters are read from the tracker's public
view (as sleep and confusion counts are), not from the belief battle's effectState.

This also fixes CENSUS 1's latent Training error for its stored-stat half: after a Power Split, Guard Split or Speed Swap on an
earlier turn, liveBuild today rebuilds the stats from the set; with `storedStats` read from the belief battle it no longer does.
The type half (Soak, Magic Powder, Reflect Type, Forest's Curse, Trick-or-Treat, Burn Up, Double Shock) is FAMILY 2's.

Training's rollout reasons left for this family: `{Name} has an Illusion.`, `{Name}: twoturnmove is not modelled.` (no Champions
Geomancy), and FAMILY 2's type-changed transform.

## 9. Contract changes (E2 and inputs)

doubles-types.ts:

```ts
// DoublesCarried (lines 95-137) gains:
/** Stockpile from earlier turns (1–3 layers) and how many raised Defense and Sp. Def (PS/data/moves.ts:17976-17994); absent: none. */
stockpile?: { layers: 1 | 2 | 3; def: number; spd: number };
/** Power Trick or Power Shift up from an earlier turn (stored Atk and Def swapped). */
powerTrick?: true; powerShift?: true;
noRetreat?: true;
minimize?: true;
/** Gastro Acid from an earlier turn: its ability (the build's) is suppressed. */
gastroAcid?: true;
/** Geomancy charged last turn: it is released this turn. */
charging?: "geomancy";
/** Trapped (Block, Mean Look, Spider Web, Jaw Lock, Anchor Shot, Spirit Shackle, Thousand Waves) from an earlier turn: No Retreat adds no volatile. */
trapped?: true;
/** Accuracy and evasion stages from earlier turns (Training; the calculator passes none). */
stages?: { accuracy?: number; evasion?: number };

// DoublesOutcomeMon (lines 345-371) gains:
/** Stockpile after the turn, as DoublesCarried.stockpile; present exactly when volatiles has "stockpile". */
stockpile?: { layers: number; def: number; spd: number };
/** Accuracy and evasion stages after the turn (MoveVolatiles.stages); absent when both are 0. */
stages?: { accuracy?: number; evasion?: number };
/** A transformed Pokémon's moves (the target's), present exactly when volatiles has "transform". */
moves?: string[];
// volatiles gains: "stockpile", "powertrick", "powershift", "noretreat", "minimize", "gastroacid", "transform", "truant", "twoturnmove", "geomancy".

// DoublesOutcome.sides[side] gains:
/** Every hazard on the side from before this turn was removed (Tidy Up; FAMILY 3's Defog and Court Change); hazards lists those that landed after. */
hazardsCleared?: boolean;
```

types.ts BuildBase gains `storedStats`, `weighthg`, `abilityChanged`, `minimized` (2v2/Training only, each documented as set only
by them). doubles-world.ts MoveVolatiles (22-54) gains `stockpile`, `powerTrick`, `powerShift`, `noRetreat`, `minimize`,
`gastroAcid` (the real ability), `charging`, `trapped`; SideState (131-137) gains `hazardsCleared`. `carriedState` (doubles-turn.ts:861-883)
maps the new carried fields (Power Trick/Shift: swap the start build's stored stats and set the volatile; Gastro Acid: the stand-in
with the real ability in `vol.gastroAcid`; stages into `vol.stages`). `carriedIssues` (2850) validates them (layers 1–3, counters
0..layers, stages −6..6, Gastro Acid not on a cantsuppress ability).

`outcomeOf` (3548-3579): the new fields, the Gastro Acid ability back; `mergeOutcomes` (3586) keys on `stockpile`, `stages`,
`moves` too. compare.ts (`../../2v2/verify/compare.ts:373-463`) compares the E2 ability, species, storedStats, weighthg,
accuracy/evasion stages and stockpile mixtures besides today's.

## 10. UI (calculator, 2v2 only)

### 10.1 Facts

Every text is a fact with names (`kernel.names`, doubles-types.ts nameText), never left/right; no instruction text
(docs/champions-calculator.md). The new texts are those quoted in §4 and §3.4-§3.5; in summary:

- Step facts: `{User} copies {Target}'s stat changes.`, `{User}'s critical-hit stages are now {Target}'s.`, `{User} and {Target}
  swap their Attack and Sp. Atk changes.` (Defense and Sp. Def; stat changes), `{User} and {Target} now have {a} Attack and {b}
  Sp. Atk.` (Defense and Sp. Def), `{User} now has {x} Speed, {Target} {y}.`, `{User} transforms into {Target}.`, `{User} gets
  {Ability}; {Target} gets {Ability}.`, `{Name} gets {Ability}.`, `{Name}'s {Ability} activates.` (a Start that acts),
  `{Name}'s Trace copies {Ability} from {Foe}.`, `{Name}'s Stockpile ends.`, `Spit Up fails: {Name} has not stockpiled.`,
  `Tidy Up: {Name}'s Substitute is removed.`, `Tidy Up: the hazards are removed from both sides.`, `{Name} charges Geomancy.`.
- Hit facts: `Its stat changes are inverted.`, `Stockpile {n}.`, `Stockpile ends.`, `Power Trick: {Name}'s Attack is {x} and its
  Defense {y}.`, `Power Trick ends: …`, `{Name} can no longer switch out.`, `Autotomize: {Name} weighs {kg} kg.`, `Its {Ability}
  is suppressed.`, `Ability Shield: {Name} keeps {Ability}.`, `Minimize: double damage.` (on a later hit), and each `{Move} fails:
  {reason}.` of §4.
- Condition facts (DoublesHP.conditions, doubles-status.ts conditions, 609-621): `Stockpile {n}.`, `Power Trick.`, `Power Shift.`,
  `No Retreat.`, `Minimized.`, `Ability suppressed.`, `Ability: {Ability}.` (when changed this turn), `Transformed into {Target}.`,
  `Charging Geomancy.`.

### 10.2 Start-of-turn facts

Turn facts (DoublesTurnResult.facts), each only when it applies: `Assumes {Name} has not stockpiled.` (its move is Stockpile,
Swallow or Spit Up, no carried layers), `Assumes {Name} has no Power Trick from an earlier turn.` (its move is Power Trick),
`Assumes {Name} has not used No Retreat.` (its move is No Retreat), `Assumes {Name} did not charge Geomancy last turn.`,
`Assumes {Imposter} transformed into {Target} as both entered.`, `Assumes {Name} has not had {Ability} before in this battle.`
(Intrepid Sword, Dauntless Shield, Supersweet Syrup gained mid-turn by a Pokémon that did not start the turn with it),
`Assumes {Name} has not used Minimize.` (a minimize-flag move can reach it and no carried Minimize).

### 10.3 Display

DoublesCard's step rows and the hit list need no new layout: the new facts go through the existing lists
(doubles-format.ts). A Pokémon whose ability changed shows `Ability: {Ability}.` among its conditions; a transformed one
`Transformed into {Target}.`.

### 10.4 Inputs (state from earlier turns)

One new control in CarriedFields (BattleConditions.tsx:125-219), offered by `carriedOptions` (doubles-prep.ts:152-214) when the
Pokémon's own move is Stockpile, Swallow or Spit Up: `Stockpile` (select 0–3; the counters equal the layers; data attribute
`data-doubles-stockpile`), counted in the summary's toggles only when above 0. Everything else from earlier turns (Power Trick,
No Retreat, Minimize, Gastro Acid, a changed ability, a split stat, a transform) has no calculator control: the turn states its
assumption (§10.2) where the move reads it, and Training passes the real state. This is a user decision (§17).

## 14. Tests

- `tests/source/doubles-ability-table.test.ts` (new): every ABILITY_TABLE entry against the pinned dex per game (flags,
  Start/SwitchIn/End/Update), and imposter.ts's lists against SV's.
- `tests/source/doubles-status-moves.test.ts`: the new kinds, handler/fails keys and snatch flags.
- `tests/unit/doubles-stats-abilities.test.ts` (new): writeStages (White Herb, no World.boosted); storedStats through makePokemon
  (rawStats and its clone), getBuildStats, turnSpeed, confusionRolls, koBoost; weighthg into Low Kick; withSpecies drops both;
  setAbility's End/Start tables (Unnerve's Berry, Cloud Nine's weather, Flash Fire's reset, the Insomnia cure, Trace's two worlds,
  Download's Wonder Room read); intimidateStart's gen gating; transformBuild's copies and keeps; Stockpile counters; Spit Up's
  context; Minimize's chain against SA13's values; carriedIssues for the new fields; the facts' exact texts (names, never
  left/right).
- `tests/unit/doubles-turn-showdown.test.ts` (generated) includes the SAT cases.
- The 1v1 golden (`../../2v2/verify/golden-1v1.ts --check`) byte-equal; the 1264 stored cases plus the SAT cases agree
  (`compare.ts`); `regress.mjs` and `app-diff.mjs` list only the S48 four and new cases as changed.
- Training: `npm run conformance:training`, `npm run leak:training` (0 differences), the eval gates.

## 15. Build plan

Disjoint ownership as the earlier build's tracks; doubles-turn.ts changes by the integrator only.

1. **Phase 1, stages**: writeStages, whiteHerbAfterMove, Acupressure, Psych Up, the three swaps, Topsy-Turvy, Tidy Up, No Retreat
   (with carried), Gear Up, Magnetic Flux, Flower Shield, Rototiller, Stuff Cheeks, Minimize (calc hook), Geomancy, Autotomize
   (weight). Cases SAT-ACU, PSY, SWP, TOP, TID, NRT, PLM, FLS, ROT, CHK, MIN, GEO, AUT.
2. **Phase 2, stored stats**: the override plumbing (types.ts, calculate.ts, model.ts, withSpecies), Power/Guard Split, Speed Swap,
   Power Trick/Shift; Training liveBuild storedStats. Cases SAT-SPD, SPL, TRK.
3. **Phase 3, Stockpile**: the volatile, the carried input, Stockpile, Swallow, Spit Up; the calculator control; tracker counters.
   Cases SAT-STK.
4. **Phase 4, abilities**: ability-table.ts and its generator, doubles-abilities.ts, the seven moves, the Update cures, the
   Intimidate option; Training's abilityChanged. Cases SAT-SKS, RPL, ENT, SBM, WSD, GAS, DDL.
5. **Phase 5, Transform and Imposter**: transformBuild, Transform, the settle's Imposter; Training's transformed builds. Cases
   SAT-TRF, IMP, S48.
6. **Phase 6 (optional), ability moves under Neutralizing Gas**: §3.4.9, with the NG cases as regression.

Budget: Acupressure ×7 and Trace ×2 worlds per use; no new calculation count beyond the later hits' (each changed build is a new
memo key). BUDGET (doubles-turn.ts:60) unchanged; the bench (`../../2v2/verify/bench.ts`) is rerun.

---

## 16. Risks

1. **The ability Start/End table's breadth.** A missed Start or End silently changes a later calculation. The ability table is
   generated from the dex and every ability with a Start, End or Update handler in each catalog is either in §3.4.4/§3.4.5's
   modelled rows or guarded by `abilityStart`/`abilityEnd`; the source test fails on an unlisted one.
2. **Fresh ability state.** `abilityActive` meanings differ per ability (model.ts:253, calculate.ts's readers); a wrong reset
   changes damage (SA14c is the check for Flash Fire; §3.4.3 moves an input Electromorphosis charge to `MonState.charged`).
3. **The stored-stat override in the calculation.** It must survive every clone the calculation makes (Parental Bond's child,
   the pairwise reruns). The unit test clones and reruns.
4. **Minimize's chain order.** The ×2 is exact in any chain position only because 8192/4096 is exact; the hook must put it in the
   same chain as Reflect, Friend Guard, Multiscale and the resist Berries, not after it (SA13).
5. **Transform's copied state.** A whole build changes; anything a world holds outside the build for the target (FAMILY 2's types,
   `vol.stages`, the crit volatiles) must be copied, and nothing of the user's that Showdown keeps may be lost (item, status, HP,
   Tera, gender, Hidden Power type).
6. **Training's leak gate** for the Stockpile counters and a changed ability between the player's allies.
7. **Speed and priority after an ability change**: gen 8+ reads per world (SA14), gen 7 frozen; Quick Claw, Quick Draw, Stall and
   Mycelium Might's fractional priority stays as fixed at queue time (PS/sim/battle.ts:2647 adds the queued action.fractionalPriority), which
   the engine already does (PendingAction.fractional).

---

## 17. What only the user can decide

1. **Calculator inputs for state from earlier turns.** Recommended: only the Stockpile layers get a control (Swallow and Spit Up
   cannot be calculated without them); Power Trick, No Retreat, Minimize, Gastro Acid, a changed ability, split stats and a
   transform stay assumption facts in the calculator and exact in Training. Alternative: a control for each (more UI).
2. **Imposter in the calculator.** Recommended: assume the Imposter holder transformed into the foe across as both entered (the
   1v1's assumption, stated as a fact). Alternative: keep `Imposter is not modelled in 2v2.`.
3. **Phase 6** (ability moves under Neutralizing Gas): in this build, or later. It only matters in SV and SwSh.
4. **Power Shift**: no Champions species learns it; it costs nothing once Power Trick exists. Build it or leave the table entry L.
5. **The once-a-battle abilities** (Intrepid Sword, Dauntless Shield, Supersweet Syrup) gained mid-turn: model with the assumption
   fact (recommended) or guard them.
